src='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_sep = next((i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1), None)
    col_sep = next((j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1), None)
    if row_sep is not None:
        a, b = grid[:row_sep], grid[row_sep+1:]
        assert len(a) == len(b)
        return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0 for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
    if col_sep is not None:
        a = [row[:col_sep] for row in grid]
        b = [row[col_sep+1:] for row in grid]
        assert len(a[0]) == len(b[0])
        return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0 for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
    raise ValueError('no full separator')
'''
